messages:
leah.sales: Heads-up — HeliosBank opened a compliance ask for the POC: they want the SOC2 system description (not full report), ISO27001 cert or network diagram, signed pen-test acceptance letter, and confirmation on whether their vuln scanner (Qualys) can run against staging. They want this bundle by next Wed.

Tom.se: Clarify: is the POC Hosted API or Dedicated single-tenant? That affects whether we can allow active scans and what infra/ips to share.

leah.sales: They explicitly requested Dedicated isolation for the trial (single-tenant). Also asked if logs can be pushed to their SIEM (Splunk) for 30-day retention.

sam.security: For Dedicated we can consider limited external scans but we need an approved scope + allowlist of scanner IPs. We provide pen-test acceptance template and will sign, but if they want vendor to access infra we need Legal sign-off on the SOW.

frank.legal: I can sign the pen-test acceptance once Security approves the scope. If HeliosBank wants us to sign their template or make special indemnity edits, expect a 3-4 business day review.

Tom.se: On logs/SIEM: we can stream telemetry (request id, latency, model id) but we avoid forwarding prompts/full user payloads. If they insist on prompts, that requires DPA + product approval.

leah.sales: They pushed back, saying their compliance team needs prompt inspection for redaction checks. Can we offer a redacted-forwarding option?

sam.security: We can offer tokenized prompt forwarding (hash + snippet) or a redaction pipeline, but that adds dev/ops work (~5 business days) and extra cost. Recommend offering metadata forward + sample prompt snapshots under NDAs.

infra-bot: ops-presign template available. Example upload for evidence bundle:

```bash
# upload evidence bundle to staging presigned URL
curl -X PUT "https://storage.redwood.example/evidence/helios/poc-bundle.zip?X-Amz-Signature=..." -H "Content-Type: application/zip" --data-binary @poc-bundle.zip
```

Tom.se: For scan access: we typically allow scanner IPs on staging for a narrow window (2-4 hours) and require credentials rotate/ephemeral. If they need continuous external scans, that's a different commercial piece.

leah.sales: Pricing question from Helios: include SIEM forwarding and scanner window in Dedicated quote. Any ballpark numbers?

Tom.se: Ballpark: Dedicated baseline +$10k/mo, one-time provisioning/setup $4k, SIEM forwarding & staging storage +$900/mo, 2-hour external scan window included once. Ongoing continuous scans or prompt retention raises price.

frank.legal: Note for contract: we add clause limiting scope of vendor scans, data retention rules, and a requirement that raw user content not be exported without explicit agreement.

leah.sales: OK team — action items for the customer dataroom: 1) SOC2 system description PDF, 2) ISO/network diagram, 3) pen-test acceptance (template to be signed), 4) short ops runbook for presigned uploads + scan window, 5) the log field map we will forward. I'll upload once presigned URL is ready.

sam.security: I'll attach the pen-test template and a proposed field map (redaction options). ETA 48h for signed letter if no contract edits.

infra-bot: presign request queued — Ops will post the link in #eng-infra within 90 minutes. Ticket #OPS-9152.
